description: Create a single-use scheduling link. Creates a scheduling link that can be used to book an event. The link allows invitees to schedule up to the specified maximum number of events. Once the limit is reached, the link becomes inactive.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a single-use scheduling link.

max_event_count.description: The max number of events that can be scheduled using this scheduling link. Must be exactly 1 for single-use scheduling links.
max_event_count.title: Max Event Count

inputSchema.title: CreateSchedulingLinkRequest

name: create_scheduling_link

CreateSchedulingLinkResponse.description: Response model containing the created scheduling link.

resource.description: The main resource object containing scheduling link details
resource.title: Resource

CreateSchedulingLinkResponse.title: CreateSchedulingLinkResponse

booking_url.description: The public Calendly booking link URL that can be shared with invitees to schedule meetings
booking_url.title: Booking Url

owner.description: URI reference to the event type that owns this scheduling link (e.g., https://api.calendly.com/event_types/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA)
owner.title: Owner

owner_type.description: Specifies the type of resource that owns this link, typically 'EventType'
owner_type.title: Owner Type
